collision_policy.candidate_scope: only the current ordinal's partition: active100 or remaining78
collision_policy.eligibility: the candidate's assigned source differs from the current row's original source and the current assigned source differs from the candidate row's original source
collision_policy.operation: swap the two assigned sources and continue; the completed 178-row mapping must have zero original-source collisions
collision_policy.selection: choose the eligible candidate with the smallest digest; equal digests or no eligible candidate are fatal

source_assignment_algorithm.mapping_commitments: the active first-100 and full-178 canonical mappings must each be SHA-256 bound after reconstruction of the exact v3b balanced sample schedule

permutation.application: construct this one fixed 64-item permutation once, then repeat it cyclically by erase ordinal; never reshuffle per cycle
permutation.ordering: ascending digest over all 64 entries; equal digests are invalid

source_assignment_algorithm.rng_rule: assignment consumes neither sample-order RNG nor noise/sigma RNG
